name: selvren-build-kit-workspace
description: Workspace source du kit Selvren (SDK, React, galerie). Non publié.

scripts.build:kit: bun run --filter @selvren/sdk build && bun run --filter @selvren/react build
scripts.build: bun run build:kit && bun run build:gallery
scripts.dev: bun run build:kit && bun run --filter selvren-build-kit dev
scripts.check: bun run --filter @selvren/sdk check && bun run --filter @selvren/react check
